nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream

avis.titre: Flaky on skin, can't see benefits
avis.texte: I thought I was the only one, but like other users it's true that the cream gets flaky. After toner (Clarifying lotion), this is the next step before putting on makeup. I only use loose or pressed powder but the product buildup is evident and gets inconvenient when I'm in a hurry most mornings. Wrinkle cream and sunscreen could have been the best combination. Luckily, I only used one 15ml jar. I It's hard to notice the benefits but I'm never using this product again.

DO NOT BUY! Peels and leaves a white cast! Very disappointed because I purchased when it was on sale thinking it was a good price and would work great but never tried right away because I was finishing off a different clinque product (moisture surge spf 28 which does not peel or flake) since the moisure surge works really good i thought this product would be the same since its the same brand and is also spf but WRONG! I passed the return window and now can't even return! Super upset because it peels within the first hour and the white cast is super noticeable! So I can no longer use this product waste of money! :(

After all the reviews stating the same thing... that this cream FLAKES off, you would think Clinique would change the formula. I used Clinique for a couple decades but with the expensive prices, I can't do it any more. The eye cream flakes too.

I would return this product but I bought it as part of a set. It completely pills and flakes. I can't use it. I've tried using it by itself. I've tried using it after Dramatically different moisturizing lotion. I've tried, using clarifying lotion and not using clarifying lotion. No matter how many combinations I have tried, it still pills. Listen to the reviews. I use Clinique Superdefense City Block SPF 50 normally. I bought this thinking I could kill two birds with one stone. No! It is the worst Clinique product I've ever tried. I've been using Clinique for 50 years.

Got a small sample and tried using this several times with different serums and lightweight foundation and same flaking happens every time. It's like rolling dried glue and you get all this white flakes peeling on face. I've had to wash my face off every time after. NOT WORTH IT. Worst product I ever used from Clinique. Discontinue this awful product!

avis.titre: I will never buy this product again
avis.texte: I have to look for a different moisturizer. I just Clinique smart wrinkle repair has BAD reviews included, me can not use this product it flakes a lot

avis.titre: Makes my foundation clump and flake off.
avis.texte: Very disappointed in this. Feels good on your skin but when you put it on underneath your Clinique makeup foundation it clumps and flakes . I bought this awhile ago and just started using it so I don't think that I can return it. Would have liked to get a refund as it is expensive.

This item just pills and flakes on the skin, no matter what I do. I am so upset because I am loyal to Clinique. I need another choice, or do I need to use sunscreen, moisturizer, and antiaging cream separtate? I would really like my money back.

avis.titre: I'll buy different product next time.
avis.texte: This product feels to sticky on my face but I may add lotions to it to see if that helps. I'll still use it when I work in yard.

I am having the same problem as other reviewers: the cream pills and flakes as soon as it dries on the skin. The overnight cream and the old Smart Repair with spf 15 didn't have this problem. I have stopped using this version. because the flaking is annoying.

Well, all I can say is, lesson learned. Always read the reviews. As others have said, this stuff is awful. Peels and flakes off and leaves white stuff all over your face. Not the look I'm going for... To make matters worse, I purchased it when they had a bunch of free gifts offered, many of which were pretty useless to me like a large bag, a notebook, etc. and these items must be returned with the product in order to return the item. Sadly I threw them out as soon as they arrived, so now I'm stuck for the cost of this useless lotion, which was not cheap. I wish they allowed exchanges in this scenario as I love most of the other products in this line. Also on a side note, I tried to remove the notebook and large bag from my cart to save the waste, but then all my free gifts were removed. I wish Clinique allowed me to accept only the gifts I want. The large bag was mailed separately and went straight into the trash.

This product is not good to use as it flakes off after it dries on your face. Please bring back Clinique Repairwear Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Uplifting Firming Cream, as it does not flake and is a great product.
Love Clinique, very disappointed in this product as it peels under makeup no matter how little one uses. The rich cream version is fabulous, but I need SPF as well.

I was really disappointed with this moisturizer. The moment I applied it, the cream started flaking off my skin, no matter how little I used or how I layered it. After more than 30 years of using this brand without a single issue, this was a first. I couldn't make it work and ultimately had to throw it out. I don't recommend this product.

Once dry, this product peels off leaving white specks all over my face and neck. I don't expect the SPF is doing its job if it peels off. I intended to wear this under makeup, but that doesn't work due to the peeling. Even without makeup it peels.

I like this cream and the feel of it but I tried this cream for about 6 months and a few wrinkles didn't change, even used with the serum. It doesn't uplift either. Personally, I prefer the Repairwear Uplifting Cream which does the trick and is alot more smoother to apply. When I called Clinique CS they told me this cream replaced the Repairwear Uplifting Cream. Please bring back.

I've been using Clinique since I was a teenager. That is close to 40 years. Now that I am older, I choose Smart repair. I do not like it at all. It does not spread well. It feels like I am applying glue. I also hate the smell. It doesn't supply enough hydration for my aging skin. The night cream is slightly better but not by much.
It doesn't absorb into the skin and flakes. Thinking about returning it for a refund.
I wanted to love this, but the pilling is just too much. It's a shame, because I really like this line.

In the jar, it looks like a regular SPF moisturizer, but when applied onto face, it's very sticky and difficult to spread. It shows white flakes in a couple of minutes after applying. When layered with foundation, it's even worse, it piles a great deal. I tried different products with it hoping the texture play out but no luck. Even paired with its own collection serum, it still has all the problems. I don't know what to do with it.

This Cream offers a wonderfully silky and smooth texture that glides effortlessly onto the skin, leaving a comfortable, non-greasy finish. It absorbs quickly and provides a perfect base under makeup. The fresh, subtle scent is invigorating yet not overpowering, making it a pleasure to use daily for effective sun protection with a luxurious feel.
I love this product. It goes on silky smooth and feels great on my skin. My skin is soft all day. Love the added protection from the sun.

I cannot say enough good things about this cream. I've been using it for about 9 months. My skin is much smoother and less lines now. It never irritated my skin which is rare for spf It absorbs pretty quickly. I'm addicted to it.

I absolutely love this product. It leaves my face feeling protected throughout the day. Many people complain about it peeling or balling up. YOU'RE USING WAY TOO MUCH. A little goes a long way. I love the way it moisturizes all day.

avis.titre: Works well for my oily skin
avis.texte: I was excited to try this new SPF cream from the Smart Clinical repair line. I really like the night creams from this line. I have had oily skin since I was a teen. I was a bit worried that this cream would be too heavy or my makeup would slide off my face in an hour. But, I was very pleasantly surprised with this new SPF day cream! It works well for my oily skin. I press it in and let it absorb before applying makeup. It is very moisturizing so I don't need an additional moisturizer on the days I use it. It brings an easy breezy feeling to my routine as far as SPF.
I tried this cream in place of previous cream in silver jar. It doesn't absorb well into my skin. I also find it tacky. Please bring back old formula!

This day wrinkle cream works well for mature skin. It absorbs well and keeps my skin feeling supple without being greasy. Most creams I've used leave my skin feeling tight and emphasize wrinkles. This makes my skin shine and healthy looking.

I've been using Clinique for 45 years now. I like this product (for the anti-aging aspects) except that it (the SPF?) flakes off when touched or while applying my Clinique makeup. Very annoying and embarrassing in public! I'm going to switch back to the Even Better Moisturizer with SPF, hoping that it does not do the same thing.

avis.titre: Yes o would buy yhos again
avis.texte: I would buy this product again because it really makes my skin look soft and d supple and smooth. I lo e .it the clinique products I would recommend to anyone that wants their skin to feel soft and smooth.

I have been using the smart clinical repair wrinkle, correcting cream for about a year and a half without any issues. I have also used the nighttime version for many months without any issues. So when I saw the smart clinical repair wrinkle correcting cream with SPF 30 I figured I might as well purchase that because sun protection is important. However, a few weeks into using it, I began developing an allergic rash around my mouth. It took me a few weeks to figure out what was causing the allergic reaction but I finally figured out it was this product. When I stopped using it, I stopped having an allergic reaction. My jar is still about 90% full but because I didn't figure out my allergy within a 30 day return window, I've now wasted a whole lot of money.

I've been using clinique smart repair serum quite well and I would like a moisturizer with SPF so I bought this. Every time I apply it, it clumps and peels and gets my face full of dandruff. At first I thought it might be that my serum was too thick. Then it clumped even if I just applied watery lotion on my face. Also it irritated my eyes. Sadly I threw it into bin just after a couple of uses.
Happy with Clinique day cream because it has spf in it. Will buy again but wait for a sale

i usually use Olay products, which I can just buy at the drugstore. But I get some haircare products from Ulta, so thought I'd see what comparable moisturizer-sunscreen they had and give it a try. I know Clinique is a good brand, but for the money, i think I'll stick w/ my much cheaper Olay product. the Clinique product just doesn't absorb into my skin as well as Olay, so i feel as if it's not doing its job as well.

avis.titre: Why is it coming off my fave in white rubbery balls
avis.texte: Just got this today, it burns so there's that and I've never had sensitive skin. And it's rolling off in little white rubbery balls all over my face and neck and even in my hair. Yuck! Would love to return but they probably wouldn't let me since I've opened and used but wow, what a disappointment!

Clinique products have been in my skincare routine for a looooong time and I love Clinique! But… this one I purchased the SPF30 option by accident and I didn't think much would be different so I kept it and now that I'm using it, it goes on nicely but after a little while it will clump all over on my face and I look like I have horribly dry skin! Like skin dandruff! Unfortunately this was a fail for me but it's too expensive to throw away so I will use it and deal with the clumps!
I'm already buying the third jar. I saw an excellent result after the first one.

This cream offers an exceptional formulation to protect the complexion from the elements. It is NOT heavy in the least, yet offers a comfortable hydrated feel to the skin. It DOES NOT peel either, contrary to "other" reviews. I feel well protected and rejuvenated with this skin care product and I am a 58 year old male!

I had been using the wrinkle correcting cream (without SPF) and thought it was a great product. When I repurchased this I was given the Broad Spectrum SPF & this stuff is terrible. It goes on fine but don't look in the mirror an hour later because your face will look like it's peeling. I thought it was me at first but then I switched back to the non-SPF and had no problems. This stuff is so expensive. What a waste of my money. I can't believe Clinique put out such a bad product. Makes to leave Clinique altogether.

I agree with a lot of the previous comments, moisturizer/sunscreen rolls right off your skin, will not be buying again. Unfortunately I don't see any other moisturizers available that are anti-aging and have sun protection…somewhat disappointing, feel as if I will have to shop elsewhere for my skin care needs even though I've been using Clinique for more than 30 years

I needed to update my facial routine. I've purchased Clinique my entire adult life so as I was traveling home from a weekend trip, I stopped at a department store that sells Clinique (as I don't live near one). I was sold this product along with moisture surge. This product feels too heavy and stays tacky all day long. I'm very disappointed, especially given the price paid. I am over my 30 days to return as I don't live near this particular department store with the ability to return.

I have been using Clinique for a long time and I was happy to see a cream with SPF, but I regret this purchase because it's too thick and dry. More importantly, it has a strong chemical smell. Don't wanna use it anymore.

In the past I used Clinique Smart Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Custom-repair Moisturizer. This was my favorite for years. Once it was discontinued I decided to try Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream. This moisturizer is horrible! It does not absorb into the skin and leaves a heavy greasy feeling which has now caused my face to breakout. Unfortunately I ordered the large jar prior to my other moisturizer running out. Since I started using this the 30 day return window has past. Such a waste of money and I still need to find another moisturizer. Note: I only used this product a little over a week.

avis.titre: Money down the drain - sticky and peels off
avis.texte: I have been a lifelong Clinique user and was so glad that the smart line came out with a 30SPF version. I didn't hesitate to supersize in preparation for summer. I should have bought the mini rather than the largest. Or better yet, none. It goes on so thick and tacky and no matter how long I wait to apply even a hint of makeup it just rolls right off then or later when touching the face. And I know it has no fragrance but it really does have that basic smell of a sunscreen. It feels as if I've put on a sunscreen made for my body accidentally on my face. I have only used it a few times and hate that I waited to finish my open jar of the regular one before opening this one.

I have used Smart Clinical Repair for a while now with no issues. However, this product caused redness, burning, swelling and itching. I wasn't sure this was what caused the allergic reaction, so I tried it once again on my neck a week later and the same thing happened. So I'm definitely allergic to something in this product.

avis.titre: Great option when higher SPF is needed
avis.texte: I have fair skin and love the option of having sunscreen in my moisturizer so I do not have to apply separately. Love the clinical repair line from Clinique

I loved Clinique Smart moisturizer with 20 spf and used it for many years. When it was discontinued, this moisturizer was recommended, so I tried it. What a mistake! I have never experienced the pilling and flaking that this product causes. I miss the old Clinique Smart!
I've used this product as directed with and without the serum and still have a problem with flaking, This is the first Clinique product I have had an issue with in 30 years. Very disappointed,

avis.titre: This was very irritating to my skin
avis.texte: I tried the smart clinical repair broad spectrum SPF 30 wrinkle correcting cream in a 2.5 oz jar. It made my face itch. I had to discard it.
I have used this, as directed, and regardless of what minimal amount I use it's still flakes terribly!

I love clinique products and use it because it is usually trustworthy especially for sensitive skin. I used this for a week and noticed a lot of dryness and chafing. While on vacation, I went back to using my smart moisturizer. When returning, I resumed using this. After a week, my face is swollen, red and burning. I was up all night with a burning sensation and can't get it to stop.

avis.titre: I Keep Trying To Use It
avis.texte: I keep going back to this and trying again and again to use it with no luck. This stuff pills no matter what is put on under it if anything. After one year I'm finally giving up and tossing it in the trash. I hate wasting product and money but I just can't anymore. Plus I'm not a fan of the fragrance.

avis.titre: Not a worthy replacement for old line.
avis.texte: I have to echo a number of the other reviews. This does not live up to the former Smart line. While I like some of the effects, it pills and is gloopy. It also took a while for my skin to get used to it and I had a few breakouts in spots where I typically do not.

I liked the previous Clinique Smart SPF 15 Custom-Repair Moisturizer with shea butter. Clinique's new Smart Clinical Repair SPF 30 strips away all the moisture in my skin and makes it feel very dry so I'm returning. I found discontinued version with Shea butter on another website and will purchase today.
Wanted to love this so much. I even bought the jumbo size right off the bat. No matter how I applied or what products I used with it, it flakes off and pills like crazy. So annoying.

avis.titre: It is good (I still miss the old line)
avis.texte: While this is a good product and I'm using it with good results - I miss the old line. It was better. The old line was smoother and less chalky - maybe the old line was more oil based?? This is good and still my preferred daytime moisturizer if I am going to be outside. The SPF makes it a bit thick and drying. I'm a man with sensitive, very dry skin - so this is almost too dry for my skin. But I like the anti-aging effects - it makes a difference and I see it in my face. This may just not be the best option for those of us with very dry skin - it needs to be more oil based. It's not gel-based so those with oily skin - well I don't know how this would work for oily skin either. Beyond the slightly drying effect and chakly SPF - it's still good and works well for anti-aging and seeing a smoother complexion. It is part of an overall routine - I think it is just a piece of the puzzle that makes my skin look great.
I used to use the Clinique cream with SPF 15 and was looking for a higher SPF cream and this is the one. It feels good.

avis.titre: Peels of with or without serum!
avis.texte: I'm so disappointed that I haven't bought a smaller size but got a biggest size straight away - wasted money!! Peels off even after cleansing and exfoliating! Peels off with a white flakes all over with or without smart serum applied before, absolutely not suitable as a makeup base. Very dissatisfied
Awful product…used it for a week and not happy, Peeks off, burns my skin, does not go on easily…wish I could return. not willing To pay shipping to return..Clinique, what were You thinking???!

avis.titre: Started with Clinique in my 20s and came back!
avis.texte: I am a Woman in my 50s who began using Clinique in my 20s. Tried other products but came back about 5 years ago. Nothing does better for my sensitive & now maturing skin. Love it
About an hour after application white flakes appear all over my skin especially around hairline and jawline.

After a decade of looking for the perfect moisturizer, a friend gave me a sample of this and it is divine. After I finished using the sample I decided it was worth the heftt investment. A little goes a long way. It's a superior product!
I have used Clinique smart for many years and this has to be the absolute worst product. Makes my skin look oily and leaves a patchy white cast.

I used this clinique smart clinical repair cream n 1 eye & used estalauder revitalizing cream on the other eye for 2 weeks. I could tell more of an improvement in my crows feet w/ this product. Ive used many eye products and this is my favorite!

avis.titre: Pills and sits on skin. Does not absorb
avis.texte: I hate this moisturizer. I replaced this with the discontinued Clinique smart broad spectrum that was discontinued and it is absolutely awful. I have never had an issue with any other Clinique product. You cannot wear foundation with this. It pills with or without makeup. It doesn't matter how long I let it "absorb" it still just sits on your skin. Before I'm told to make sure that my skin is clean and fully exfoliated before using, I assure you that it is. I was unable to return this because I had received a free gift with my order and had already used it, so it was a waste of money.

As many others have mentioned, this product peels/pills and leaves white bits on my skin. I see from many reviews that Customer Service blames technique, but I cleanse and exfoliate and this still happens. Time to stop blaming us and fix the formula! This never happened with the old, Smart with SPF 15. Can't justify the price for poor quality!

avis.titre: Does Clinique actually listen to their longtime customers
avis.texte: The ONLY moisturizer I've ever loved was Clinique Broad Spectrum Custom Repair. Could not believe they discontinued that. A rep suggested this replaced that and I'd love it. Hate it. Pills up and I've seen a negative change in my skin since. Disgusted. Clinique lately discontinue and changes all the excellent products. Just like my favorite primer. They new ones are awful. Looks like I need to find a new skincare line which stinks. Took years to find these. Stop discontinuing products people love
This moisturizer pills on freshly washed and exfoliated skin. I will be returning it.
This was thick, probably due to the spf. I didn't feel like it really soaked in to my skin. My makeup seemed to sit on top of my skin and it appeared dry.
It's not good at all for dry skin. I bought for eye & cream for face. When I touch my face it separates into little white pieces. It was a waste of money I can't use it.

I was a long time user of the previous Smart SPF 15 moisturizer which worked great under my foundation. As others have said, this product tends to pill on my skin and is too heavy. I've been a devoted Clinique user for decades but find myself having to look elsewhere for products that work well for me.

avis.titre: I would use this product again and again
avis.texte: I have used this product for years. I will keep using this product.

I have used Clinique all my adult life. After putting this on in the morning it is impossible to put any other makeup on. When I touch my face it separates into little white pieces. It was a waste of money I can't use it. I loved the moisturizer this replaced.

I tried this (gad I only got the small size) because my usual broad spectrum SPF15 has been discontinued and this was recommended as a replacement. I agree with other reviewers that it's very thick and pills badly so my face looks as though I have an unattractive skin condition. I love Clinique products and will continue to use, but this was a disappointment and will go in the trash.
This product is very dry and sometimes leaves a visible residue on the skin.

avis.titre: Pills up and is terrible under foundation
avis.texte: I was a devoted fan of the Smart custom-repair cream with SPF 15 but it has disappeared and I was told replaced with the Smart clinical repair SPF 30. Well, no matter what I try -- smaller amount, working it in, waiting before foundation -- the cream will pill up and make these dandruff-like white flakes on my face and neck. It also keeps my foundation from blending in to my skin. Please, bring back the old cream or lessen the SPF or something. No one needs SPF 30 for normal everyday wear.

I have very fair skin and have always used Clinique Smart SPF 15, it"s perfect. The SPF 30 is far too thick and clogs the pores creating blemishes. And, unless you're planning to spend the day outside, is totally unnecessary. Why take away our choice? Unfortunately I too will have to look elsewhere for my needs.
This SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream works great on skin, moisturized and fully protected

avis.titre: Created blobs of cream on my face
avis.texte: Clinique customer for over thirty years...first time I've been disappointed with a product. Cream did not absorb into my skin and left blobs all over my face.

I used the Superdefense moisturizer for decades, and it worked perfectly for my aging, acne prone yet sensitive combination skin. When that was discontinued, the salesperson suggested this cream. My pores feel stifled, and it pills under even a small amount of makeup. Not what I was expecting at this price point. I've used Clinique skincare products for 40 years. Time to start the long process of searching for a new day moisturizer with SPF, as well as a cleanser (they have also discontinued the one I've used for decades).

I recently purchased this from Belk. I normally love smart clinical repair and love it. When I saw it now comes with SPF 30 I was very excited! However, after using it for a few weeks I absolutely HATE it! It is sticky on my skin and does not make me feel good about my skin at all. Also, When I use it I end up with the taste of sunblock in my mouth all day long. So gross. I can't wait until it is all gone and I can go back to my usual smart clinical repair. I do not recommend anyone buy this. Yuck!

I was really looking forward to using this product, as it has 30 SPF, instead of 15, but unfortunately, even with well cleansed and exfoliated skin, and using only a tiny, tiny amount, and completely blending in the moisturizer, if I happen to touch my face later, it pills up, extensively. When I try to brush all the white pilling away, even more pills up.

This cream is thicker than I'd like but I could live with that. What I can't live with is how it pills up on my face. I have white specks all over my face and in my hairline. I've tried waiting 30 minutes after applying before I apply foundation, but it still pills up. Yuck.

avis.titre: Clinique Needs to Rework this Formula
avis.texte: I've been using the Clinique "Smart" day cream for over a decade—back when it was only 15 spf. I've always loved the Smart collection—the smooth creamy texture, and the way it made my skin look refreshed within seconds of putting it on. But this new 30spf formula is not as high quality as previous versions of this cream. It feels chalky upon putting it on, it has a white cast, and I can't put my normal sunscreen on top of it (it pills it up, which it didn't do on the previous versions of "Smart"). It's a bummer because it's great that this one is 30spf, but it seems that the quality had to be sacrificed. Clinique, bring back the old formula, please!

Clearly every quality product does not work on every skin, that does not mean it's an ineffective product. But for my aging dry skin, (living in Florida), it works PERFECTLY as a lightweight moisturizer and sunscreen. THANK YOU Clinique for all of your professional efforts!

avis.titre: It's Good To Read the Reviews!
avis.texte: I was excited to see the SPF 30 in this new product, ordered it right away and didn't read the reviews. I wish I had! This moisturizer is the first Clinique product I have been very unhappy with. It is heavy on the skin and after a few hours these white "flakes" appear and is very embarrassing.

The cream moisturizes but is heavy and sits on my skin. I find it too heavy for summer use. The spf 30 is a nice addition to this moisturizer but there are many sunscreens designed for faces are more cost effective and works just as well. I prefer the older discontinued cream, Even Better™ Skin Tone Correcting Moisturizer spf 25 much better. I will not be purchasing this item again.
I was so excited that clinique finally had an spf over 15. But I hate the way this feels on my skin period it feels like a goopy sunscreen and not like a facial moisturizer.

I have been using Clinique products since I was in my early teens. Never have I had one of their products behave this way on my skin. I was looking for a replacement for the Superdefense Multi-Correcting Cream, which was somehow discontinued. This cream flakes and sheds, no matter when you apply it to your skin. It's not usable. Remarkable that a cream so expensive cannot absorb appropriately. Bring back the Superdefense Multi-Correcting Cream!

I really love this product. It is a great product for dry skin. I have read a lot of people say it piles on your skin. I don't use foundation just powder and it is fantastic with a powder over it. I really love that by the end of the day my skin looks and feels just like it did when I first applied it. It gives me a really nice glow and I use it daily. It is great sun protection. I have been out in the sun for extended periods of time and didn't get any sun at all.
I used this product everyday I like the way my skin stays moisturized

HATE HATE HATE HATE the new formula! No matter how thin of a layer I apply, if I touch my face too hard (like applying face powder with a brush), it flakes and looks like my face has dandruff. Not even aggressively rubbing it onto my face solves the flaking issue; but who wants to rub their face aggressively anyway? I'll be finding a different product.

This does make one's skin look nice, but it is impossible to layer anything at all over it. If you intend to wear makeup of any kind, I cannot recommend this product. That said, if you just want a moisturizer with spf, this is good. But for the price tag, it shouldn't flake off this badly.

I was excited to have this wrinkle correcting cream with SPF 30, given other products in this line are excellent. I even started with the big 2.5 oz. jar. That was a mistake. I figured that I used too much at the first few tries, given Clinique suggestions for use. Nope. I warmed my dime size portion and spread it thinly over my face. As the day goes on, I still feel like I have a thin coating of ointment on my face, and it is still pilling. I am going to request a refund, or at least account credit for the cost.

I like how this helps me combat wrinkles and the early signs of aging. It has a smooth texture that is lightweight on my skin. I pay it in my problematic areas and blend it in. It helps keep my skin firm. It is recommended for all skin types. It comes in a jar that I can easily access when I need it.

I love Clinique products and have used almost every SPF moisturizer they've sold without any issues. But for some reason, this moisturizer will not stay on my face. I apply as normal over my serums and go about my day, but after a few hours I'll notice it basically crumbling off of my face. If I see an area that looks to be peeling and go to rub it in, the entire area I'd touch will then also start to peel off. It's gross and makes me feel like I have a skin condition. I'm not sure if it's the formula or just my specific skin type, but I'll be replacing this ASAP.

I was so excited to get this product. I've used the Clinique Smart SPF 15 moisturizer for years, and I was thrilled to see that they created an SPF 30 formula. Before I am able to apply my foundation the moisturizer is pilling up on my skin. By the time I get the little clumps off my face I no longer get the SPF benefit. So sad! Very disappointed.

As someone with sensitive skin, it's hard for me to find the right products that won't cause a reaction. However, I really like this correcting cream! It's lightweight, cooling, and doesn't leave my face feeling shiny. My only concern was that it left a little pilling on my face after a while, but this only occurred once. Overall, I would recommend this product!

I have been looking for a face cream that can repair lines and wrinkles and the same time provide protection and hydration and I found it with Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Wrinkles Correcting Cream. It is very light that allows the skin to breathe and does not cause clogged pores. Another thing I like is that it does not cause my face greasy even though I have oily skin. And it is so convenient, I don't have to put a layer of face cream and a layer of sunscreen on my face. Just one layer is enough.

I was super disappointed when i went to get more of the clinique smart moisturizer/sunscreen that i use every day. it has been replaced with this --i used it for the first time this morning and it literally feels like i have oily glue on my face--ugg--all the votes arent in yet but i'll probably be returning this and looking for another line--i miss the light feel of the other--and there is no option for dry or oily -its all the same-disappointed for sure!

Product packaging is appealing and professional looking. The scent is similar to a very mild sunscreen. Texture is light and creamy. After putting on a light layer there is no stickiness after drying. Overall, this is a pleasant product to use and would buy again.
Texture of the cream was very nice. Didn't take too long to soak into my skin. Scent is pleasant and not overwhelming. Haven't noticed skin texture changes but we'll see over time!
I love this product! The product is thick, creamy, it jhas great coverage, and protects against UV sun exposure! I used it multiple times already, and it makes my skin so soft.

First I don't care for the consistency of it. It is different than the free sample I had of it previously. This one has "broad spectrum SPF 30" which the sample did not and which apparently changed its consistency. I prefer the old version much more. I felt my skin absorbed it and it actually seemed to be working. This does not absorb and it just sits on my skin, dries, and then flakes off. And I don't see any improvement in my skin. I am very disappointed in this product.
I don't know why but this makes my face very red, burning sesnsation. I loved smart cream, tought this will be better since it is new but I have made a mistake.

avis.titre: First time user of Smart Clinical Repair
avis.texte: Smart Clinical Repair seems to be useful for my facial problems. I like its smoothness which leaves my skin feeling soft. I also like the sunscreen it provides.

I do love that this product is non scented! It softens my skin while leaving me feel hydrated and refreshed. I use this product every night before bed. It's a good price for the amount you get in the container!
I returned this product because it pilled under makeup and alone. I tried it for a week and even exfoliated as recommended by Clinique representative.
I can't really review how this worked on wrinkles because I don't have any. It was a thick cream but absorbed nicely and will likely use as a sunscreen in the summer because it didn't feel heavy.
I do not have wrinkles so o have the product to my mom for her to try it out and she likes the product. It's very gentle on the skin and she likes how moisturizing the product is to her under eyes.

This cream is super hydrating and leaves my skin feeling really nice. Clinique has always been a go to brand for me for cosmetics and I really enjoy the skincare lines as well! While this is on the pricier end, it is worth checking out.

I got this product to sample, and I can say I have noticed a change. Since I started using it about two months ago I have noticed that my dark spots have slowly started to fade away! This product provides great sun protection to help release your wrinkles and dark spots!

This cream is incredible, it sinks into the skin beautifully without leaving a white cast, it's hydrating but not greasy, and it leaves my skin looking so smooth. I really appreciate that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or break me out. Not to mention the packaging is beautifully weighted glass and feels really substantial.
I have very dry skin & this day time cream seems to hydrate all day long,

Wanted to love... Applies on like sunscreen, easily blends in. All is well till you decide to touch your face. Was noticing white flecks on my black shirt then saw my face. Yep... It's the new lotion pilling off.

As someone in their late thirties concerned about preventing and correcting signs of aging, I've been on the lookout for a moisturizer that offers both sun protection and wrinkle correction. Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream fits the bill perfectly. The texture of this cream is luxurious yet lightweight, making it comfortable to wear under makeup or on its own. It absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving behind a velvety finish that doesn't feel greasy or heavy. One of the standout features of this cream is its wrinkle-correcting abilities. Formulated with Clinique's innovative technology, it targets lines and wrinkles, visibly improving their appearance over time. I've noticed a reduction in the fine lines around my eyes and mouth since incorporating this cream into my skincare routine. The addition of SPF 30 is a huge bonus. Sun protection is essential for preventing further damage to the skin and minimizing the appearance of wrinkles. I love that I can rely on this cream for both hydration and sun protection without having to layer multiple products. Despite containing SPF, the cream doesn't have that typical sunscreen smell and doesn't leave a white cast on my skin. It's also fragrance-free, which is great for those with sensitive skin like mine. The packaging is sleek and practical, with a pump dispenser that ensures hygienic and mess-free application. I'm really funny about how products sit on my skin and this one was not great. It applies very white and feels very thick and heavy. Then after about 10 minutes it starts rubbing off every time I touch my face. I work as a cna and wipe my face periodically for sweat. It just feels weird.

This cream is very very thick, kind of like spackle lol and smells similar to it, very chemically. It doesn't apply even on the skin, doesn't feel very hydrating and it starts "peeling off". I don't think I'll continue using this product even though I usually like Clinique products

This product is really good for correcting while having sun protection. I gave it four stars because it is not perfect wearing under makeup. It kind of left my face looking like it had texture showing any dry spots. But I rather have that than have sun damage. So I would overall say that this is a win and this is a great product for all by itself. The scent is very light and almost nothing compared to other sunscreens. Does not leave a huge white cast like other SPF products. I didn't notice a light and effect on any wrinkles while wearing it alone, although I'm sure it would be even more effective after I use the whole bottle.

I've used Clinique's dramatically different moisturizer since I was a teenager, so I was excited to try this one. It doesn't have a white cast and doesn't feel too sunscreeny, which is awesome. It moisturizes well - I can't comment too much on the wrinkle correction aspect but as a moisturizer it's great!
